description: Inventory overview for a rikma: how many products are active, archived, low, out of stock, and per-variant stock. Also loads the waiting orders and any oversold (short) units so the seller knows what the shelf does not cover. Members only. This is what the Stock tab of sales/manage shows, as facts an agent can act on. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getShopInventoryTool

includeArchived.description: Count archived products in the totals. Default false.

name: getShopInventoryTool
